a: Multi-stage builds compile in one stage and copy artifacts into a slim runtime image.
Order Dockerfile instructions from least to most changing to maximize layer cache hits.
.dockerignore excludes files from the build context (like .gitignore).
HEALTHCHECK tells orchestrators if a container is still healthy.
Volumes persist data beyond container lifetime.
User-defined bridges let containers resolve each other by name.
depends_on controls start order but not full readiness; use healthchecks.
ENTRYPOINT is the main executable; CMD supplies default args.
Run as non-root user in images to reduce privilege risk.
Scan images for CVEs before deploying to production.
